title: crataegus monogyna subsp. curvisepala
intro: Crataegus monogyna subsp. curvisepala, commonly known as the Hawthorn tree, is a subspecies of the Crataegus monogyna species, which belongs to the Rosaceae family. This deciduous shrub or small tree is native to Europe and Asia, and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Crataegus monogyna subsp. curvisepala include its ability to reduce blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, anti-arrhythmic, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular and metabolic disorders.
